title: Resource observation v1: structural validity does not establish live readiness
x-semantic-validation: Validate projection equals normalized resource fields; schema cannot compare their values.
Resolve catalog/owner IDs and rights/evidence references independently; strings are not authority.
Require current rights/access, operation/destination eligibility, source vintage and expiry against as_of.
Reject duplicate JSON keys and non-finite numbers at parse time.
Require lexicographically sorted unique derived_from and rights operation/destination arrays.
Exactly64 bare hex read compatibility normalizes document fields before validation;32 bare staysunverified.
Hash complete normalized descriptor without output hashes; hash stable_projection separately.
Raw retention metadata claims must be verified against tracked original and manifest bytes; no live attestation here.
Preserve exact owner-issued source_id and dataset_id; do not invent namespace; catalog source authority is llm-wiki:data/data-source-catalog.yml.
Require source_vintage <= observed_at <= as_of; verified_at and rights.checked_at <= as_of; rights/freshness valid_until > as_of. All comparisons use RFC3339 instants.

Originals: required_pending is explicit blocked ingest, never retained evidence. Single dataset path segment; root manifest.locator supplies the retained-original manifest. Edition is resource.source_version; authorized access evidence is rights.evidence_ref.
